verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the open-source library's showcased example tasks. One fills a job application "with my resume", which implies a file upload; another extracts follower data and exports it "as a CSV", which implies a file artifact. Neither example documents how downloads, uploads or artifact retrieval actually work. Missing for 10: documented file upload to sites, documented capture of browser downloads, an API or mechanism to retrieve artifacts after a run (cloud or local), and hands-on corroboration.
